name: KeshVruddhi Herbal Hair Mask
descriptor: Deep conditioning Ayurvedic scalp and hair shaft repair mask
fullDescription: A transformative hair repair treatment blending wild Bhringraj, Neem, and cold-pressed seed oils. Restores hair density, reduces follicle stress, and eliminates stubborn scalp flaking.
benefits: Reduces hair breakage by up to 85%
usageInstructions: Apply generously onto damp scalp and hair lengths. Leave for 30 minutes before washing with a mild botanical cleanser.

name: Shuddhi Pure Herbal Face Mask
descriptor: Purifying clay & botanical mask for deep dermal detox
fullDescription: Crafted with detoxifying Fuller's earth, Holy Tulsi, and Neem extract. Clears micro-pollutants, absorbs excess sebum, and refined texture without stripping skin oils.
benefits: Unclogs pores for a smooth complexion
usageInstructions: Smooth an even layer over face and neck. Allow to dry for 15 minutes, then rinse gently with lukewarm water.

name: Aura Ubtan Face Mask Powder
descriptor: Traditional sun-dried bridal Ubtan for luminous glow
fullDescription: Heritage sun-dried Ayurvedic formulation enriched with Kashmiri Saffron strands, wild Turmeric, and Gram Flour. Gently polishes dead cells for instant radiance.
benefits: Evens out skin tone and sun tan
usageInstructions: Mix 1 tbsp with raw milk or rose water to form a smooth paste. Massage onto skin and wash gently when semi-dry.

name: Eterna-AgeReset Advanced Anti-Ageing Serum
descriptor: Phyto-retinol Bakuchiol serum for collagen elasticity
fullDescription: High-potency botanical elixir featuring 2% Himalayan Bakuchiol and Kashmiri Saffron. Accelerates cellular turnover and visibly softens fine lines without irritation.
usageInstructions: Dispense 3-4 drops onto clean fingertips. Press into clean face and neck gently before bedtime.

name: Scalp Revitalizing Herbal Serum
descriptor: Follicle stimulating botanical elixir for root density
fullDescription: Lightweight, non-greasy micro-elixir powered by Bhringraj and Holy Tulsi. Awakens dormant roots and fortifies hair anchorage for visibly thicker hair.
usageInstructions: Apply a full dropper along hair partings twice daily. Massage softly with fingertips. Do not wash off.

name: Waterless Face Wash Spray
descriptor: No-rinse herbal cleanser mist for instant freshness
fullDescription: Revolutionary waterless facial mist infused with steam-distilled Holy Tulsi hydrosol and Neem extracts. Cleanses environmental debris on the go.
benefits: Instantly cools and hydrates stressed skin
Zero harsh surfactants or artificial fragrance
usageInstructions: Spritz 3-4 sprays directly onto face. Gently wipe off with a clean cotton pad or cloth.

name: Sparsh Moisturizing Cream
descriptor: Rich Ayurvedic barrier repair cream with pure ghee & herbs
fullDescription: Deeply nourishing barrier defense cream featuring 100-times washed pure Cow Ghee (Shata Dhauta Ghrita), Saffron, and Phyto-ceramides.
usageInstructions: Take a pea-sized amount, warm between palms, and gently pat onto face and neck till absorbed.

name: Under Arm Roll On
descriptor: Natural alum & sandalwood roll-on for odor control
fullDescription: Natural crystal alum and organic Sandalwood roll-on serum. Neutralizes odor-causing microbes and lightens underarm hyperpigmentation safely.
usageInstructions: Glide roll-on ball smoothly onto clean, dry skin after showering. Allow 1 minute to dry.

name: Herbal Natural Inhaler
fullDescription: Aromatic pocket inhaler charged with pure essential oils of Holy Tulsi, Eucalyptus, and Ajwain. Opens nasal passages and calms sensory stress instantly.
benefits: Instant sinus and nasal breath clarity
usageInstructions: Inhale deeply through each nostril as needed throughout the day for clarity and refreshment.
